fix(messaging): persist report lastRunAt so schedules survive restarts

Scheduled reports used a plain setInterval with no record of when they
last fired, so any process restart reset the countdown to zero. A 1d
schedule on a service that restarted more than once per day could run
indefinitely without firing.

Persist lastRunAt on every tick and, on startup, resume the timer with
the remaining delay (or run immediately if overdue).

feat(messaging, trading-strategies): wizards, list tables, NoopStrategy

- /accountAdd, /watchAdd, /strategyAdd now run as interactive Telegram
  wizards (inline keyboards + text prompts). Secret messages from
  /accountAdd are auto-deleted after receipt, and credential validation
  is guarded by a 10s timeout so the Alpaca Infinity-retry loop can't
  hang the flow.
- /help renders as a numbered list; /accountList, /watchList,
  /strategyList, /reportList render via a shared fixed-width table
  helper (bold header + fenced monospace block).
- Start platforms before monitors and fire-and-forget monitor startup
  so a stuck exchange WebSocket during subscription can't block the
  command surface.
- Normalize command names to camelCase in all user-facing usage text.
- trading-strategies: add NoopStrategy for smoke-testing the
  monitor/scheduler pipeline without placing trades.

fix(messaging): wizard cancel/pivot, parallel conversations, no secrets in logs

- Mark all Telegram conversations (trade, accountAdd, watchAdd,
  strategyAdd) as parallel so non-matching updates fall through to the
  command middleware. Without this the plugin drops them by default,
  which meant typing /watchAdd during an active /accountAdd was silently
  ignored and a global /cancel could never fire during a callback-only
  wait.
- Add /cancel command (listed in /help) that exits any active wizard
  via ctx.conversation.exit(name).
- Auto-exit any in-flight wizard in #registerWizardCommand before
  entering a new one, so /watchAdd during /accountAdd's picker pivots
  cleanly.
- waitForTextOrCancel helper used in every text prompt: detects
  /command input and exits the wizard with a resend-your-command
  message. accountAdd also deletes the sent message and cancels when
  the API key / secret prompt receives a /command — keeping the secret
  out of the chat history.
- Stop logging raw axios errors on wizard failure — the request config
  carries API key / secret headers. Now only error.message is logged.
